Mastering: Argues both sides. Reasons for initial rejection: Mendel was an obscure monk with no formal scientific position; his work was published in a minor journal; the mathematical approach was unfamiliar to biologists of the time; there was no known mechanism to explain how 'factors' were passed on. Balanced conclusion with explicit criteria. (9 marks)
